blocker_status.title: Fixture crosswalk and disjoint ranking population
blocker_status.status: CLOSED (architecture implemented; coverage gap remains, see remaining_blockers)
blocker_status.before: live path loaded tests/fixtures/discovery01/m4_identity_crosswalk_v1.json (21 rows); no candidate list was sent; all 20 M4 parts absent from the catalog; identity_mapped_exact 0; facet narrowing could not influence ranking
blocker_status.fix: Owner-approved architecture implemented: cohort.select_candidates() extracted so the facet renderer and the transport cannot disagree; candidate_transport.build_identity_crosswalk() generates the mapping from the identity store on every request (deterministic, versioned, release-bound, evidence-backed, coverage measured, unmapped explicit, no fuzzy joins); build_candidate_scope() sends the explicit population (canonical_id, opn, manufacturer, grain, discovery-level eligibility_state, identity, provenance) with crosswalk identity, both releases, selection context, match rule and a payload sha256; facet-unplaced unknowns are transported flagged rather than dropped; oversized populations fail closed (candidate_population_too_large) instead of truncating; unsolicited M4 entries are stripped and reported as ranking_population_violation; response adds a full ranking_population disclosure with accounting and the assertion ranking_population == discovery_candidate_population; candidate_results carries one row per sent candidate. M4 (curve/08c-parity-repair@f02f08a2) accepts candidate_scope, matches exact identities only, reports received/matched/unresolved with reasons, never substitutes its universe, and answers an empty scope with an empty result. Legacy path retained but labeled out_of_cohort with promotion_blocked_while_normal_path and is the only fixture caller
